integrity.description: The agent did not simply display a text file claiming success.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The recording file must be 'OpenBCI-EEG-S001-EyesOpen.txt'. The Focus widget must be set to 'Alpha' and specifically to 'Channel 8'. Note that the dataset contains exactly 8 channels, so Channel 8 is the final available channel in the stream.
